13-3.solution: Highest + lowest \(= 11 \times 45 - 9 \times 42 = 495 - 378 = 117\), and highest - lowest \(= 80\). So the highest is \(\frac{117 + 80}{2} = 98.5\).

13-9.solution: Oldest + youngest \(= 40 \times 35 - 38 \times 34 = 1400 - 1292 = 108\), and oldest - youngest \(= 45\). So the youngest is \(\frac{108 - 45}{2} = 31.5\) years.
